content:
I can’t determine the most likely next items from only the information that item 794 was purchased. That requires transaction or co-purchase data for item 794 and other items.

If you provide the dataset or co-occurrence counts, I can compute the top 10 item IDs.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 794. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
